# AICPA Trust Services Criteria (SOC 2)

- Source: <https://www.aicpa-cima.com/resources/download/2017-trust-services-criteria-with-revised-points-of-focus-2022>
- Version used: 2017 criteria with revised points of focus (2022); criteria text checked against the AICPA 2020 edition, criteria unchanged in 2022
- Type: Attestation criteria (an auditor's report, not a certification)
- Access: free AICPA account required
- Checked: 2026-10-15

| Control | What it covers | Checklist items | How we checked |
|---|---|---|---|
| C1.1 | Identify and maintain confidential information (confidentiality, if in scope) | [DAT-02](../checklist.md#dat-02) | verified |

| CC2.3 | Communicate with external parties on matters affecting internal control | [INC-02](../checklist.md#inc-02) | verified |
| CC3.4 | Identify and assess changes that could affect internal control | [CHG-01](../checklist.md#chg-01) | verified |
| CC6.1 | Logical access controls protect information assets | [ACC-01](../checklist.md#acc-01) | verified |
| CC6.2 | Users registered and authorized before credentials are issued | [ACC-02](../checklist.md#acc-02) | verified |
| CC6.3 | Access granted by role, with least privilege and segregation of duties | [ACC-01](../checklist.md#acc-01), [ACC-02](../checklist.md#acc-02), [TMP-03](../checklist.md#tmp-03) | verified |
| CC6.6 | Protection against threats from outside the system boundary | [ACC-03](../checklist.md#acc-03) | verified |

| CC7.5 | Recover from identified security incidents | [INC-03](../checklist.md#inc-03) | verified |
| CC8.1 | Changes authorized, designed, tested, approved and documented | [CHG-02](../checklist.md#chg-02) | verified |
| CC9.2 | Assess and manage risks from vendors and business partners | [SUB-01](../checklist.md#sub-01), [SUB-02](../checklist.md#sub-02) | verified |
